formula: X recorded the highest / lowest figure among all categories
note: Коли треба виділити одне значення серед багатьох рядків таблиці.
example: Norway recorded the highest figure among all the countries listed, at 98%.

exercises.practice: Looking at the table, Norway had the best score of all the countries, 98%.
exercises.answer: Norway recorded the highest figure among all the countries listed, at 98%.
exercises.answerNote: "had the best score of all" → академічне recorded the highest figure among.

exercises.practice: Sweden had the best recycling rate in the table, 68%, and Poland had the worst, 22%.
exercises.answer: Sweden recorded the highest figure among all the countries listed, at 68%, while Poland recorded the lowest, at 22%.
exercises.answerNote: Одне речення описує і найвище, і найнижче значення відразу.

exercises.practice: Looking at the table, Product A sold the most units and Product D sold the fewest.
exercises.answer: Product A recorded the highest figure among all the products listed, while Product D recorded the lowest.
exercises.answerNote: Формула працює для товарів так само, як і для країн.

formula: There was considerable variation between X and Y
note: Загальна фраза, коли рядки таблиці сильно відрізняються.
example: There was considerable variation between the regions in terms of average income.

exercises.practice: The regions in the table had very different average incomes.
exercises.answer: There was considerable variation between the regions in terms of average income.
exercises.answerNote: "had very different" → there was considerable variation between... in terms of.

exercises.practice: The table shows that exam results were quite different between the five schools.
exercises.answer: There was considerable variation between the five schools in terms of exam results.
exercises.answerNote: "the table shows that... were quite different" — прибрали зайве, лишили головну структуру.

exercises.practice: Customer satisfaction scores were quite different across the branches in the table.
exercises.answer: There was considerable variation between the branches in terms of customer satisfaction scores.

formula: X was consistently higher than Y across all years
note: Коли одна колонка таблиці ЩОРАЗУ більша за іншу.
example: Urban population was consistently higher than rural population across all the years shown.

exercises.practice: In every year in the table, city population numbers were bigger than countryside numbers.
exercises.answer: Urban population was consistently higher than rural population across all the years shown.
exercises.answerNote: "in every year... were bigger than" → consistently higher than... across all years.

exercises.practice: In every year shown, sales in the north were bigger than sales in the south.
exercises.answer: Sales in the north were consistently higher than sales in the south across all the years shown.
exercises.answerNote: Та сама структура: "consistently... across all years" замінює "in every year".

exercises.practice: Every year in the table, the cost of petrol was higher than the cost of diesel.
exercises.answer: The cost of petrol was consistently higher than the cost of diesel across all the years shown.
exercises.answerNote: Формула ідеальна саме для таблиць із кількома роками поспіль.

formula: The data reveals a stark contrast between X and Y
note: Хороша фраза для вступу перед аналізом таблиці.
example: The data reveals a stark contrast between spending levels in 2000 and 2020.

exercises.practice: Looking at the numbers, spending in 2000 was very different from spending in 2020.
exercises.answer: The data reveals a stark contrast between spending levels in 2000 and 2020.
exercises.answerNote: "looking at the numbers... very different from" → the data reveals a stark contrast between.

exercises.practice: Comparing the numbers, unemployment in 1990 was very different from unemployment in 2020.
exercises.answer: The data reveals a stark contrast between unemployment levels in 1990 and 2020.
exercises.answerNote: Та сама формула, інші роки й тема.

exercises.practice: The figures show a big difference between test scores in Group A and Group B.
exercises.answer: The data reveals a stark contrast between test scores in Group A and Group B.
exercises.answerNote: "the figures show a big difference" → "the data reveals a stark contrast".

formula: Overall, X outperformed Y in every category except [Z]
note: Коли один рядок таблиці кращий за інший майже скрізь, крім одного винятку.
example: Overall, Country A outperformed Country B in every category except literacy rate.

exercises.practice: Looking at the whole table, Japan did better than Italy in almost everything apart from tourism numbers.
exercises.answer: Overall, Japan outperformed Italy in every category except tourism numbers.
exercises.answerNote: "did better than... apart from" → outperformed... except — коротше й точніше.

exercises.practice: In general, Team A did better than Team B in every statistic apart from assists.
exercises.answer: Overall, Team A outperformed Team B in every category except assists.
exercises.answerNote: "in general" → "overall" — стандартний вступ до підсумкового речення.

exercises.practice: Generally, the new model was better than the old model in every test except battery life.
exercises.answer: Overall, the new model outperformed the old model in every category except battery life.
exercises.answerNote: Формула працює і для порівняння продуктів, не лише країн чи команд.
